patch_description: This replaces evolutionary crossover with a deterministic continuation-based force-field optimizer. It optimizes a smooth soft-minimum of all 165 normalized triangle areas, whose gradient concentrates automatically on the currently smallest triangles. A population of perturbed structured and random simplex layouts is evolved simultaneously by projected Adam-style ascent, with annealed smoothing, controlled kicks, and periodic elite reseeding. This directly attacks active near-degenerate triples rather than relying on random mutation acceptance.
